source: Derived from tests/comparative/test_dataset_enhanced.py (D1-D6, S1-S4, E1-E4, H1-H4, A1-A10). Each (claim, passage) triple is grounded in a real question from the test suite; ground_truth_support reflects whether the passage substantively supports the claim.
calibration_notes: This set is used by compute_quantile_from_calibration() (T015) to choose the conformal abstention quantile via expected-loss minimization. Each entry is a (claim, passage, ground_truth_support) triple. The verifier outputs a per-passage support probability; the conformal layer thresholds the combined posterior.
